mapper.sql: EMP_NO, NAME, ROLE, POSITION_TITLE, APPROVAL_GRADE, STATUS, FAILED_LOGINS, LAST_LOGIN_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USERS ORDER BY EMP_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS (EMP_NO, NAME, ROLE, POSITION_TITLE, APPROVAL_GRADE, STATUS, FAILED_LOGINS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{name}, #{role}, #{positionTitle}, #{approvalGrade}, #{status}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET LAST_LOGIN_AT = #{now}, FAILED_LOGINS = 0 WHERE EMP_NO = #{empNo}
